CommunityApplications.Profile: Templates for [Tidemark](https://tidemarkanalytics.com), privacy-first web analytics: one calm dashboard, no cookies, no stored IP addresses. Tidemark is open source (MIT) and also runs on ordinary PHP shared hosting. Documentation is at [docs.tidemarkanalytics.com](https://docs.tidemarkanalytics.com). For help, open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/tidemark-analytics/tidemark/issues).
